deals.comment: LINE Corporation signed a definitive agreement to acquire MixRadio from Microsoft Corporation (NasdaqGS:MSFT) for ¥2.29 billion on December 18, 2014. Post acquisition, the team that developed MixRadio, along with the MixRadio leadership team, will join the new company, and continue to be headquartered in Bristol, United Kingdom. The deal is expected to close in early 2015.
LINE Corporation (TSE:3938) acquired Wit Studio Co., Ltd. from BonAngels Venture Partners and other shareholders for approximately ¥150 million on July 25, 2014.

LINE Vietnam Co., Ltd. agreed to acquire Adways Technology Vietnam JSC from Adways Inc. (TSE:2489) and others for VND 46.2 billion on February 23, 2017. The consideration will be satisfied in cash. Adways Technology Vietnam JSC reported revenues of VND 43.6 billion for the year ended December 31, 2016. Board of Directors of Adways Inc. resolved the transaction on February 23, 2017. The transaction is expected to close on April 1, 2017.

LINE Pay Corporation acquired Line Biz Plus Corporation from LINE Biz+ PTE. LTD. for KRW 2.8 billion on November 6, 2017. Under the terms of the transaction, LINE Pay Corporation acquired 0.8 million shares at KRW 3,550 per share.

deals.sellers: East Ventures Pte. Ltd.; STRIVE, Inc.; Donuts Co., Ltd.; i Mercury Capital
deals.comment: LINE Corporation (TSE:3938) signed an agreement to acquire Five Inc. on December 4, 2017. As per terms, 1,448 shares will be acquired. Post completion Five Inc. will become the wholly owned subsidiary of LINE Corporation. The transaction is expected to close by mid of December 2017. The impact of this acquisition on the consolidated results of LINE Corporation is expected to be minimal.
